why_ai: Regulated, network-connected payment rails stay essential and AI-driven commerce adds volume.
why_clarity: Authorisation rate is one measurable number over billions of near-identical transactions.
why_digital: Transactions in, authorisations and settlements out, all over networks.

why_ai: Retry, routing and token decisions are predictions over an existing outcome record.
why_clarity: Authorisation rate is an exact metric, with settlement outcomes arriving in two days.
why_digital: Transaction data in, routing and retry decisions out.

why_ai: Every retry ever made has a labelled settlement outcome, so models replace schedules.
why_clarity: Recovered revenue per decline is measurable on every attempt within days.
why_digital: Decline codes and settlement files in, retry decisions out.

why_ai: Interchange qualification follows published, checkable rules that software applies automatically.
why_clarity: Each transaction either qualified at the right rate or did not.
why_digital: Transaction data and fee schedules in, corrected submissions out.

why_ai: Adversarial fraudsters adapt, but this is a well-posed prediction problem with abundant labels.
why_clarity: Fraud and dispute outcomes label every decision, though chargebacks arrive weeks later.
why_digital: Transaction signals in, block or allow decisions out.

why_ai: Verification against public registries is automatable, though credit judgment carries loss exposure.
why_clarity: High-volume decisions whose losses are never attributed back to the decision.
why_digital: Registry data and websites in, approval decisions out.

why_ai: Mining labelled network-scale records is machine learning, protected only by the unique vantage point.
why_clarity: Complete, labelled approval and settlement records make findings testable.
why_digital: Network transaction records in, analytics out.

why_ai: Routing choices are decidable by models, but network relationships are not.
why_clarity: Approval probability per presentation choice is measured on every transaction.
why_digital: Transaction presentation choices made in software across networks.

why_ai: Matching counterparties' reports is mechanical work now done in spreadsheets.
why_clarity: Totals either agree across counterparties or they do not.
why_digital: Settlement files in, reconciled ledgers out.

why_ai: The same twenty integration questions recur, and diagnosis from logs is automatable.
why_clarity: Recurring questions with a working checkout as quick, objective confirmation.
why_digital: Logs and code in, fixes and answers out, fully remote.

why_ai: Evidence gathering by browsing is automatable, leaving a credit judgment that AI increasingly assists.
why_clarity: Many similar cases, but underwriters never learn which decisions were right.
why_digital: Websites and processing history in, approval decisions out.
